title: Hymn of Everlasting Peace (Jingrwai Shaphang Ka Jingsuk)
cultural_context: Meditative devotional hymn on the peace (*Jingsuk*) that transcends all earthly fear and tribulation, from 'Ki Jingrwai Ai-nguh Blei'.

khasi: Ka jingsuk ba u Blei u la ai,
Ka long kum ka wah kaba tuid jai-jai;
Kam ju khihwin ha ki eriong ba jur,
Hynrei ka iaineh ha ka dohnud;
Haba ka pyrthei ka pynkhuslai ia ngi,
Ka ai ia ka bor ban kmen,
english: The sacred peace bestowed by God,
Is like a river flowing tranquilly and calm;
Disturbed not by the wildest mountain gales,
Dwelling steadfast within the human heart;
When the world burdens us with sorrow and grief,
This divine peace brings cooling solace;
Even amidst earthly trials and distress.

khasi: To ai kane ka jingsuk kan shong,
Ha man ki kur bad ki kha jong ngi;
Ban pynphriang ia ka jingieit ha ka ri,
Ai nguh ia U Blei Trai Kynrad,
Uba ai ia kane ka spah bakordor;
Ngin rwai ia ka burom jong U
Ha man ka step bad ka miet.
english: May this peace take up its permanent abode,
Among all our maternal clans and paternal kin;
Diffusing brotherly love across the land,
Uniting all children of the Seven Huts;
Give praise unto God, our Sovereign Lord,
Who has gifted us this most priceless treasure;
We shall sing of His majesty and glory
Through every morning dawn and twilight night.
